title: Keys Derive-and-Sign-Document — payload
description: Derive a key at a path and return the supplied JSON document with a Data Integrity proof grafted on. Unlike keys/derive-and-sign, the custodian canonicalizes the document itself.

keyType.description: Algorithm to derive. MUST be one that can sign.

document.description: The JSON document to sign. Any `proof` member present is stripped before canonicalization — the custodian signs the document's content, never a previous signature over it.

proofPurpose.description: Proof purpose to record in the generated proof. Absent means `assertionMethod`.

Response.title: Keys Derive-and-Sign-Document — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a keys/derive-and-sign-document request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/keys/derive-and-sign-document/0.1#response.

signerDid.description: The `did:key` of the derived signer — the identity the document was signed as, and the DID a verifier resolves the proof's verification method against.

document.description: The document with the Data Integrity `proof` grafted on.
